limitations: Pure VIA cannot activate review-diff Accept or Reject buttons unless the app exposes corresponding keyboard-shortcut commands.
Approve request and Decline request act on active permission requests, not individual review diffs.
Custom commands may vary by ChatGPT desktop app version and account rollout. Leave a signal unbound if its named command is unavailable.
notes: Toggle Voice uses native Control-Shift-V while ChatGPT is focused; Global Voice uses the configurable Command-Option-F13 hotkey from anywhere.
Assign Command-Option-F13 in Settings > Voice > Voice chat hotkey by pressing the physical Global Voice key.
Assign the effort chords and F13-F22 in Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts by performing the physical control while the shortcut recorder is active.
Direct F13 for Open model picker is distinct from modified Command-Option-F13 for Voice chat.
No config.toml changes, firmware flashing, Hammerspoon, or background automation are required.
